en: Instantly gain 500 Materials, then go 300 into debt
Lets you overspend in the shop, up to {0} into debt
Everything in the shop is bought on unlimited credit
Enemies gain +1% Health and Damage for every 5 debt you carry
Your debt gains 5% interest at the end of every wave
Materials repay your debt and grant XP but no money
Prices are shown as the debt they add, in red
While in debt you gain no Materials until it is repaid, and every point of debt costs 2 Materials to clear
